quote: In particular, an important factor in the quality of farmed fish is whether the fish performed exercise training prior to being slaughtered.
statement: 特别是，养殖鱼质量的一个重要因素是鱼在屠宰前是否进行了运动训练。
text_zh: 特别是，养殖鱼质量的一个重要因素是鱼在屠宰前是否进行了运动训练。
text_en: In particular, an important factor in the quality of farmed fish is whether the fish underwent exercise training before slaughter.

quote: Fish in the HFT group had the highest level of hypoxanthine among all groups (Fig. 3 F).
statement: HFT组的鱼在所有组中次黄嘌呤水平最高。
text_zh: HFT组的鱼在所有组中次黄嘌呤水平最高。
text_en: Fish in the HFT group had the highest hypoxanthine levels among all groups.
intervention_record: 高脂饮食结合有氧运动

quote: Meanwhile, ET also significantly decreased the bitter FAA content when fish were fed a medium-fat diet (Fig. 3 k).
statement: 同时，当鱼饲喂中脂日粮时，有氧运动训练也显著降低了苦味游离氨基酸含量。
text_zh: 同时，当鱼饲喂中脂日粮时，有氧运动训练也显著降低了苦味游离氨基酸含量。
text_en: Meanwhile, when fish were fed a medium-fat diet, aerobic exercise training also significantly reduced the content of bitter free amino acids.

quote: HFD significantly decreased the EAA content whether fish received ET or not.
statement: 高脂饮食显著降低了必需氨基酸含量，无论鱼是否接受有氧运动训练。
text_zh: 高脂饮食显著降低了必需氨基酸含量，无论鱼是否接受有氧运动训练。
text_en: A high-fat diet significantly reduced essential amino acid content, regardless of whether the fish underwent aerobic exercise training.

quote: ET significantly decreased the EAA content when fish were fed a medium-fat diet (Fig. 3 L).
statement: 当鱼饲喂中脂日粮时，有氧运动训练显著降低了必需氨基酸含量。
text_zh: 当鱼饲喂中脂日粮时，有氧运动训练显著降低了必需氨基酸含量。
text_en: When fish were fed a medium-fat diet, aerobic exercise training significantly reduced essential amino acid content.

quote: Currently, it is becoming common to treat premarket farmed fish with in-water exercise without feeding to improve muscle quality.
statement: 目前，在水中进行不喂食的运动处理以改善养殖上市前鱼的肌肉质量变得普遍。
text_zh: 目前，在水中进行不喂食的运动处理以改善养殖上市前鱼的肌肉质量变得普遍。
text_en: Currently, performing exercise in water without feeding to improve the muscle quality of farmed fish before market is becoming common.

quote: Although higher alkalinity reduced growth performance, feed efficiency, altered gill structure and ion regulation, and decreased meat quality (protein, amino acids, fatty acids, and muscle texture) to some extent, the survival rate was not affected, and the fish still maintained relatively high nutritional quality.
statement: 较高的碱度在一定程度上降低了生长性能、饲料效率，改变了鳃结构和离子调节，并降低了肉质（蛋白质、氨基酸、脂肪酸和肌肉质地），但存活率未受影响，且鱼仍保持相对较高的营养品质。
text_zh: 较高的碱度在一定程度上降低了生长性能、饲料效率，改变了鳃结构和离子调节，并降低了肉质（蛋白质、氨基酸、脂肪酸和肌肉质地），但存活率未受影响，且鱼仍保持相对较高的营养品质。
text_en: Higher alkalinity reduced growth performance and feed efficiency to some extent, altered gill structure and ion regulation, and decreased flesh quality (protein, amino acids, fatty acids, and muscle texture), but survival rate was unaffected, and the fish maintained relatively high nutritional quality.
outcome: 生长性能、饲料效率、鳃结构、离子调节、肉质及存活率

quote: To maintain good growth performance and meat quality, alkalinity should be controlled below 20 mmol/L.
statement: 为了保持良好的生长性能和肉质，应将碱度控制在20 mmol/L以下。
text_zh: 为了保持良好的生长性能和肉质，应将碱度控制在20 mmol/L以下。
text_en: To maintain good growth performance and flesh quality, alkalinity should be controlled below 20 mmol/L.

quote: Fish were collected by scanning about 20 m lengths of the river during 20 minutes in every station by electrofishing (SAMUS) on the upper sites of Karamenderes.
statement: 在卡拉门德雷斯河上游站点，使用电捕鱼设备（SAMUS）对约20米长的河段扫描20分钟以采集鱼类。
text_zh: 在卡拉门德雷斯河上游站点，使用电捕鱼设备（SAMUS）对约20米长的河段扫描20分钟以采集鱼类。
text_en: At the upstream site of the Kalamendres River, fish were collected by scanning a river section approximately 20 meters long for 20 minutes using electrofishing equipment (SAMUS).

quote: This can be mitigated by appropriate feeding of HFD.
statement: 通过适当投喂高脂饲料可以缓解这一负面影响。
text_zh: 通过适当投喂高脂饲料可以缓解这一负面影响。
text_en: Appropriate feeding of high-fat diet can alleviate this negative effect.

quote: This indicates that when the population of C. gibelio low density, they prefer the most available and abundant plant materials as food.
statement: 当鲫鱼种群密度较低时，它们倾向于选择最易获得且丰富的植物性材料作为食物。
text_zh: 当鲫鱼种群密度较低时，它们倾向于选择最易获得且丰富的植物性材料作为食物。
text_en: When the population density of crucian carp is low, they tend to select the most accessible and abundant plant-based materials as food.

quote: After anesthesia with MS-222, blood was drawn from the caudal vein and stored at 4 °C for 24 h.
statement: 在采集血液样本前，使用MS-222对鱼进行麻醉。
text_zh: 在采集血液样本前，使用MS-222对鱼进行麻醉。
text_en: Fish were anesthetized with MS-222 before blood samples were collected.
outcome: 采样过程中的应激管理

quote: Additionally, nine fish per tank were anesthetized and dissected.
statement: 为了收集肌肉组织等样本，每缸九条鱼被麻醉并解剖。
text_zh: 为了收集肌肉组织等样本，每缸九条鱼被麻醉并解剖。
text_en: To collect samples such as muscle tissue, nine fish per tank were anesthetized and dissected.

quote: Periphyton was important diet as frequency and abundance, as well as IRI %, in almost all length groups.
statement: 在几乎所有长度组中，周丛生物作为重要饮食，其频率、丰度以及IRI百分比均较高。
text_zh: 在几乎所有长度组中，周丛生物作为重要饮食，其频率、丰度以及IRI百分比均较高。
text_en: In almost all length groups, periphyton had high frequency, abundance, and IRI percentage as an important diet.

quote: The amount of animal food might be enough only large specimens who are more capable to collect the animal materials comparing to smaller ones, so the smaller ones have to change their feeding characteristics into algae because of competition.
statement: 动物性食物的量可能仅足够那些比小个体更有能力收集动物材料的大个体，因此由于竞争，小个体不得不将其摄食特征转变为藻类。
text_zh: 动物性食物的量可能仅足够那些比小个体更有能力收集动物材料的大个体，因此由于竞争，小个体不得不将其摄食特征转变为藻类。
text_en: The amount of animal food may be sufficient only for large individuals that are more capable of collecting animal material than small individuals, and therefore, due to competition, small individuals have to shift their feeding characteristics to algae.

quote: Compared with the control group, FBW, WGR, and SGR were significantly reduced, and FCR and FR were significantly increased in the alkalinity-treated groups
statement: 与对照组相比，碱度处理组的终末体重、增重率和特定生长率显著降低，饲料系数和摄食率显著增加。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，碱度处理组的终末体重、增重率和特定生长率显著降低，饲料系数和摄食率显著增加。
text_en: Compared with the control group, the final body weight, weight gain rate, and specific growth rate in the alkalinity treatment group were significantly decreased, while the feed conversion ratio and feeding rate were significantly increased.

quote: All experimental groups exhibited 100% survival.
statement: 所有实验组的存活率为100%。
text_zh: 所有实验组的存活率为100%。
text_en: The survival rate of all experimental groups was 100%.

quote: As a primary stressor in saline-alkaline water, carbonate alkalinity adversely affects key biological processes in aquatic animals, from growth and physiological metabolism to tissue function and nutritional value
statement: 作为盐碱水中的主要应激源，碳酸盐碱度对水生动物的关键生物过程产生不利影响，从生长和生理代谢到组织功能和营养价值。
text_zh: 作为盐碱水中的主要应激源，碳酸盐碱度对水生动物的关键生物过程产生不利影响，从生长和生理代谢到组织功能和营养价值。
text_en: As the main stressor in saline-alkaline water, carbonate alkalinity adversely affects key biological processes of aquatic animals, from growth and physiological metabolism to tissue function and nutritional value.
outcome: 生长、生理代谢、组织功能及营养价值

quote: For example, alkaline stress reduced the activities of intestinal proteases, lipases, and amylases, and significantly impaired the growth performance of grass carp (Ctenopharyngodon idella)
statement: 例如，碱性胁迫降低了草鱼肠道蛋白酶、脂肪酶和淀粉酶的活性，并显著损害了其生长性能。
text_zh: 例如，碱性胁迫降低了草鱼肠道蛋白酶、脂肪酶和淀粉酶的活性，并显著损害了其生长性能。
text_en: For example, alkaline stress reduced the activity of intestinal protease, lipase and amylase in grass carp, and significantly impaired its growth performance.
outcome: 消化酶活性与生长性能

quote: Furthermore, under alkaline stress, Scatophagus argus exhibited excessive production of reactive oxygen species (ROS), which induced oxidative stress, disrupted the balance within the
statement: 此外，在碱性胁迫下，金钱鱼表现出过量的活性氧（ROS）产生，这诱导了氧化应激，破坏了体内的平衡。
text_zh: 此外，在碱性胁迫下，金钱鱼表现出过量的活性氧（ROS）产生，这诱导了氧化应激，破坏了体内的平衡。
text_en: In addition, under alkaline stress, Scatophagus argus exhibited excessive production of reactive oxygen species (ROS), which induced oxidative stress and disrupted the balance within the body.

quote: A previous study indicated that alkalinity stress altered serum immune parameters, suppressed antioxidant enzyme activities, and caused oxidative damage in crucian carp
statement: 先前的研究表明，碱度应激改变了鲫鱼的血清免疫参数，抑制了抗氧化酶活性，并导致氧化损伤。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，碱度应激改变了鲫鱼的血清免疫参数，抑制了抗氧化酶活性，并导致氧化损伤。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that alkalinity stress altered serum immune parameters in crucian carp, inhibited antioxidant enzyme activity, and led to oxidative damage.

quote: long-term high-alkalinity stress can disrupt hepatic antioxidant capacity and lipid metabolism, while triggering apoptosis and immune responses
statement: 长期高碱度应激可破坏肝脏抗氧化能力和脂质代谢，同时触发细胞凋亡和免疫反应。
text_zh: 长期高碱度应激可破坏肝脏抗氧化能力和脂质代谢，同时触发细胞凋亡和免疫反应。
text_en: Long-term high alkalinity stress can disrupt liver antioxidant capacity and lipid metabolism, while triggering apoptosis and immune responses.

quote: This stress can also induce severe kidney injury by disrupting kidney antioxidant defenses and energy homeostasis, and suppressing protein catabolism and metabolism
statement: 这种应激还可通过破坏肾脏抗氧化防御和能量稳态，并抑制蛋白质分解代谢，诱导严重的肾损伤。
text_zh: 这种应激还可通过破坏肾脏抗氧化防御和能量稳态，并抑制蛋白质分解代谢，诱导严重的肾损伤。
text_en: This stress can also induce severe kidney damage by disrupting renal antioxidant defenses and energy homeostasis, and inhibiting protein catabolism.

quote: The percentage of empty guts, vacuity index (VI %), were used to assess the feeding intensity (Hureau 1966).
statement: 空胃百分比、饱满度指数（VI %）用于评估摄食强度（Hureau 1966）。
text_zh: 空胃百分比、饱满度指数（VI %）用于评估摄食强度（Hureau 1966）。
text_en: Empty stomach percentage and fullness index (VI %) are used to assess feeding intensity (Hureau 1966).

quote: Vacuity Index (VI) was used for calculating the feeding intensity by using VI = empty gut number x 100 / total gut number equation (Hureau 1966; Costa and Cabral 1999).
statement: 通过公式 VI = 空胃数 x 100 / 总胃数 计算摄食强度（Hureau 1966; Costa and Cabral 1999）。
text_en: 通过公式 VI = 空胃数 x 100 / 总胃数 计算摄食强度（Hureau 1966; Costa and Cabral 1999）。

quote: For gill tissues, thawed samples were homogenized in 0.85% normal saline and centrifuged (6000 rpm, 10 min, 4 °C). The resulting supernatant was used to determine total protein concentration, NKA activity, and CMA activity with commercial kits.
statement: 鳃组织样本在生理盐水中匀浆并离心后，上清液用于测定总蛋白浓度、NKA活性和CMA活性。
text_zh: 鳃组织样本在生理盐水中匀浆并离心后，上清液用于测定总蛋白浓度、NKA活性和CMA活性。
text_en: After gill tissue samples were homogenized in physiological saline and centrifuged, the supernatant was used to determine total protein concentration, NKA activity, and CMA activity.
outcome: 鳃部生理功能与应激状态

quote: Histological analysis was performed using hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) staining... Gill and muscle samples from three fish randomly selected in each group were sectioned... The sections were stained with H&E...
statement: 对每组随机选取的三条鱼的鳃和肌肉样本进行苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色以进行组织学分析。
text_zh: 对每组随机选取的三条鱼的鳃和肌肉样本进行苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色以进行组织学分析。
text_en: Histological analysis was performed by hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) staining of gill and muscle samples from three fish randomly selected per group.

quote: During the acclimation period, the dissolved oxygen was maintained at ≥7.0 mg/L, ammonia nitrogen at 2.2.
statement: 在驯化期间，溶解氧维持在≥7.0 mg/L，氨氮维持在2.2（单位缺失）。
text_zh: 在驯化期间，溶解氧维持在≥7.0 mg/L，氨氮维持在2.2（单位缺失）。
text_en: During the acclimation period, dissolved oxygen was maintained at ≥7.0 mg/L, and ammonia nitrogen was maintained at 2.2 (unit missing).

quote: According to our previous study, the safe concentration of the alkalinity stress for juvenile Qihe crucian carp was 20.79 mmol/L [ 32 ].
statement: 根据之前的研究，齐河鲫鱼幼鱼碱胁迫的安全浓度为20.79 mmol/L。
text_zh: 根据之前的研究，齐河鲫鱼幼鱼碱胁迫的安全浓度为20.79 mmol/L。
text_en: According to previous research, the safe concentration of alkaline stress for juvenile Qihe crucian carp is 20.79 mmol/L.

quote: Throughout the 60 d experiment, the fish were fed manually until they appeared to be satiated twice daily (at 09:00 and 16:00) with a commercial expanded diet purchased from Henan Tongwei Feed Co., Ltd. (Xinxiang, China).
statement: 在整个60天的实验中，每天两次（09:00和16:00）手动投喂商业膨化饲料直至鱼只看似饱食。
text_zh: 在整个60天的实验中，每天两次（09:00和16:00）手动投喂商业膨化饲料直至鱼只看似饱食。
text_en: Throughout the 60-day experiment, commercial extruded feed was manually fed twice daily (at 09:00 and 16:00) until the fish appeared satiated.

population.system: 室内温控温室静态养殖系统

quote: Mortality was checked each morning before feeding.
statement: 每天早晨喂食前检查死亡率。
text_zh: 每天早晨喂食前检查死亡率。
text_en: Mortality is checked every morning before feeding.

population.system: 室内温控温室静态养殖系统

quote: To maintain water quality, 50% of the tank water was replaced two hours after morning feeding and continuous aeration was provided throughout the experiment.
statement: 为维持水质，上午喂食两小时后更换50%的池水，并在整个实验期间提供连续曝气。
text_zh: 为维持水质，上午喂食两小时后更换50%的池水，并在整个实验期间提供连续曝气。
text_en: To maintain water quality, 50% of the pond water was replaced two hours after morning feeding, and continuous aeration was provided throughout the experiment.

population.system: 室内温控温室静态养殖系统

quote: The results revealed an inverse relationship between alkalinity concentration and CF, but a positive relationship with HSI (Figure 2).
statement: 碱度浓度与肥满度呈负相关，但与肝体比呈正相关。
text_zh: 碱度浓度与肥满度呈负相关，但与肝体比呈正相关。
text_en: Alkalinity concentration was negatively correlated with condition factor, but positively correlated with hepatosomatic index.
outcome: 形态指标（肥满度和肝体比）

quote: No significant differences were observed in VSI among the groups (p > 0.05).
statement: 各组间的脏体比没有显著差异。
text_zh: 各组间的脏体比没有显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference in the hepatosomatic index among groups.

quote: the CA20 group exhibited significant reductions only in SL and CPH compared to the control group
statement: 与对照组相比，CA20组仅在鳞长和尾柄高上表现出显著降低。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，CA20组仅在鳞长和尾柄高上表现出显著降低。
text_en: Compared with the control group, the CA20 group showed significant decreases only in scale length and caudal peduncle height.

quote: Although the physiological, biochemical, and molecular responses of crucian carp to alkaline stress have been extensively characterized, it is still unclear whether long-term alkaline stress affects their important economic traits such as growth performance and muscle quality.
statement: 虽然鲤鱼对碱性胁迫的生理、生化和分子反应已被广泛表征，但长期碱性胁迫是否影响其生长性能和肌肉质量等重要经济性状尚不清楚。
text_zh: 虽然鲤鱼对碱性胁迫的生理、生化和分子反应已被广泛表征，但长期碱性胁迫是否影响其生长性能和肌肉质量等重要经济性状尚不清楚。
text_en: Although the physiological, biochemical, and molecular responses of common carp to alkaline stress have been widely characterized, it remains unclear whether long-term alkaline stress affects important economic traits such as growth performance and muscle quality.

quote: However, it remains unknown whether the growth, morphology, physiology, histology, and muscle quality of Qihe crucian carp would change under medium-high saline-alkaline water conditions.
statement: 然而，在中高盐碱水条件下，齐河鲫的生长、形态、生理、组织学和肌肉质量是否会发生变化仍未知。
text_zh: 然而，在中高盐碱水条件下，齐河鲫的生长、形态、生理、组织学和肌肉质量是否会发生变化仍未知。
text_en: However, it remains unknown whether the growth, morphology, physiology, histology, and muscle quality of Qihe crucian carp change under medium-to-high saline-alkaline water conditions.
outcome: 生长、形态、生理、组织学及肌肉质量

quote: Chronic alkalinity stress did not significantly alter serum K + , Mg 2+ , Cl − concentrations compared to the control group (Figure 3 ; p > 0.05).
statement: 慢性碱度胁迫与对照组相比，未显著改变血清K+、Mg2+和Cl-浓度。
text_zh: 慢性碱度胁迫与对照组相比，未显著改变血清K+、Mg2+和Cl-浓度。
text_en: Compared with the control group, chronic alkalinity stress did not significantly change serum K+, Mg2+ and Cl- concentrations.

quote: Alkalinity stress significantly improved the concentration of Na + (p
statement: 碱度胁迫显著提高了Na+的浓度。
text_zh: 碱度胁迫显著提高了Na+的浓度。
text_en: Alkalinity stress significantly increased the concentration of Na+.

quote: After 60 d of alkalinity stress, gill NKA and CMA activities exhibited opposing trends (Figure 4).
statement: 经过60天的碱度胁迫后，鳃NKA和CMA活性表现出相反的趋势。
text_zh: 经过60天的碱度胁迫后，鳃NKA和CMA活性表现出相反的趋势。
text_en: After 60 days of alkalinity stress, gill NKA and CMA activities showed opposite trends.

quote: NKA activity showed a significant increasing trend with rising alkalinity levels (Figure 4 A; p Figure 4 B; p Figure 4 NKA and CMA activities in gills of Qihe crucian carp Carassius Carassius after 60 d alkalinity stress.
statement: 随着碱度水平的升高，NKA活性显示出显著的增加趋势。
text_zh: 随着碱度水平的升高，NKA活性显示出显著的增加趋势。
text_en: As alkalinity levels increased, NKA activity showed a significant increasing trend.

quote: Key water parameters were monitored daily to keep them consistent with the temporary rearing conditions.
statement: 每天监测关键水质参数，以保持其与临时饲养条件一致。
text_zh: 每天监测关键水质参数，以保持其与临时饲养条件一致。
text_en: Monitor key water quality parameters daily to keep them consistent with temporary holding conditions.

quote: After the experiment, all fish in each tank were starved for 24 h, and then counted and weighed to calculate final body weight (FBW), survival rate (SR), specific growth rate (SGR), feeding rate (FR), weight gain rate (WGR), and feed conversion ratio (FCR).
statement: 实验结束后，每个水箱中的所有鱼禁食24小时，然后计数并称重以计算终体重、存活率、特定生长率、摄食率、增重率和饲料系数。
text_zh: 实验结束后，每个水箱中的所有鱼禁食24小时，然后计数并称重以计算终体重、存活率、特定生长率、摄食率、增重率和饲料系数。
text_en: After the experiment ended, all fish in each tank were fasted for 24 hours, then counted and weighed to calculate final body weight, survival rate, specific growth rate, feeding rate, weight gain rate, and feed conversion ratio.

quote: Ten fish per tank were then anesthetized with MS-222 (100 mg/L).
statement: 随后每箱取10条鱼用MS-222（100 mg/L）进行麻醉。
text_zh: 随后每箱取10条鱼用MS-222（100 mg/L）进行麻醉。
text_en: Subsequently, 10 fish were taken from each box and anesthetized with MS-222 (100 mg/L).

quote: Thereafter, three additional fish per tank were anesthetized. Their BW and BL were recorded before they were dissected on ice to collect and weigh the visceral mass and hepatopancreas, allowing for the calculation of the condition factor (CF), viscerosomatic index (VSI), and hepatosomatic index (HSI).
statement: 此后，每箱再取三条鱼进行麻醉，记录其体重和体长后在冰上解剖以收集并称量内脏团和肝胰腺，从而计算肥满度、脏体比和肝体比。
text_zh: 此后，每箱再取三条鱼进行麻醉，记录其体重和体长后在冰上解剖以收集并称量内脏团和肝胰腺，从而计算肥满度、脏体比和肝体比。
text_en: Thereafter, three fish from each box were anesthetized again; their body weight and body length were recorded, and they were dissected on ice to collect and weigh the viscera and hepatopancreas, thereby calculating the condition factor, viscerosomatic index, and hepatosomatic index.

quote: For example, in Piaractus mesopotamicus , gill NKA activity was significantly increased when exposed to alkaline waters [ 22 ].
statement: 例如，在Piaractus mesopotamicus中，暴露于碱性水体时，鳃NKA活性显著增加。
text_zh: 例如，在Piaractus mesopotamicus中，暴露于碱性水体时，鳃NKA活性显著增加。
text_en: For example, in Piaractus mesopotamicus, exposure to alkaline water significantly increased gill NKA activity.

quote: Thus, the activities of these enzymes typically changed when aquatic animals were subjected to alkalinity stress [ 6 ].
statement: 因此，当水生动物遭受碱度胁迫时，这些酶的活性通常会发生改变。
text_zh: 因此，当水生动物遭受碱度胁迫时，这些酶的活性通常会发生改变。
text_en: Therefore, when aquatic animals are subjected to alkalinity stress, the activity of these enzymes usually changes.

quote: Saline-alkaline water environments can disrupt key physiological processes in aquatic animals, such as osmotic homeostasis, energy metabolism, and gut microbiota [ 10 ].
statement: 盐碱水环境可能破坏水生动物的关键生理过程，如渗透压稳态、能量代谢和肠道微生物群。
text_zh: 盐碱水环境可能破坏水生动物的关键生理过程，如渗透压稳态、能量代谢和肠道微生物群。
text_en: The saline-alkaline water environment may disrupt key physiological processes of aquatic animals, such as osmotic homeostasis, energy metabolism, and gut microbiota.
outcome: 生理过程干扰（渗透压、代谢、菌群）

quote: Specifically, following chronic exposure to 14 mmol/L alkalinity stress, the muscle of largemouth bass (Micropterus salmoides) exhibited significant increases in the concentrations of most amino acids, as well as in the contents of total amino acid (TAA), essential amino acid (EAA), and delicious amino acid (DAA).
statement: 具体而言，在长期暴露于14 mmol/L碱度胁迫后，大口黑鲈(Micropterus salmoides)的肌肉表现出大多数氨基酸浓度以及总氨基酸(TAA)、必需氨基酸(EAA)和鲜味氨基酸(DAA)含量的显著增加。
text_zh: 具体而言，在长期暴露于14 mmol/L碱度胁迫后，大口黑鲈(Micropterus salmoides)的肌肉表现出大多数氨基酸浓度以及总氨基酸(TAA)、必需氨基酸(EAA)和鲜味氨基酸(DAA)含量的显著增加。
text_en: Specifically, after long-term exposure to 14 mmol/L alkalinity stress, the muscle of largemouth bass (Micropterus salmoides) showed a significant increase in most amino acid concentrations and the contents of total amino acids (TAA), essential amino acids (EAA), and delicious amino acids (DAA).

quote: This indicates an improvement in amino acid nutritional quality [ 23 , 24 ].
statement: 这表明氨基酸营养品质的改善。
text_zh: 这表明氨基酸营养品质的改善。
text_en: This indicates an improvement in amino acid nutritional quality.

quote: Compared to the control group, both alkalinity-treated groups exhibited a significant decline in muscle water-holding capacity, as evidenced by reduced pH and stored loss, alongside increased cooked rate and frozen leakage
statement: 与对照组相比，两个碱度处理组的肌肉持水力显著下降，表现为pH值和贮存损失降低，以及熟化率和冷冻泄漏增加。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，两个碱度处理组的肌肉持水力显著下降，表现为pH值和贮存损失降低，以及熟化率和冷冻泄漏增加。
text_en: Compared to the control group, muscle water-holding capacity significantly decreased in both alkalinity treatment groups, manifested as reduced pH and storage loss, and increased cooking yield and freeze-thaw drip.

quote: muscle texture softened with increasing alkalinity, characterized by decreased hardness and gumminess but increased resilience
statement: 随着碱度增加，肌肉质地变软，表现为硬度和胶着性降低，但弹性增加。
text_zh: 随着碱度增加，肌肉质地变软，表现为硬度和胶着性降低，但弹性增加。
text_en: As alkalinity increases, muscle texture becomes softer, manifested as decreased hardness and gumminess, but increased elasticity.

quote: under alkaline stress, Scatophagus argus exhibited excessive production of reactive oxygen species (ROS), which induced oxidative stress, disrupted the balance within the antioxidant system, and subsequently caused structural and functional damage to gill tissues
statement: 在碱性胁迫下，斑点圆鲀表现出活性氧（ROS）的过度产生，这诱导了氧化应激，破坏了抗氧化系统内的平衡，并随后导致鳃组织的结构和功能损伤。
text_zh: 在碱性胁迫下，斑点圆鲀表现出活性氧（ROS）的过度产生，这诱导了氧化应激，破坏了抗氧化系统内的平衡，并随后导致鳃组织的结构和功能损伤。
text_en: Under alkaline stress, spotted pufferfish exhibited excessive production of reactive oxygen species (ROS), which induced oxidative stress, disrupted the balance within the antioxidant system, and subsequently led to structural and functional damage to gill tissue.
outcome: 氧化应激与鳃组织损伤

quote: moderate levels of carbonate alkalinity could help maintain the stability of water pH and ions, reduce the toxicity of metal ions in the water, as well as promote fish growth
statement: 中等水平的碳酸盐碱度有助于维持水体pH值和离子的稳定性，降低水中金属离子的毒性，并促进鱼类生长。
text_zh: 中等水平的碳酸盐碱度有助于维持水体pH值和离子的稳定性，降低水中金属离子的毒性，并促进鱼类生长。
text_en: Moderate levels of carbonate alkalinity help maintain the stability of water pH and ions, reduce the toxicity of metal ions in the water, and promote fish growth.

quote: excessive alkalinity can disrupt acid–base balance, impair antioxidant and ammonia metabolism functions, trigger metabolic alkalosis, and ultimately result in growth suppression
statement: 过高的碱度会破坏酸碱平衡，损害抗氧化和氨代谢功能，引发代谢性碱中毒，并最终导致生长抑制。
text_zh: 过高的碱度会破坏酸碱平衡，损害抗氧化和氨代谢功能，引发代谢性碱中毒，并最终导致生长抑制。
text_en: Excessively high alkalinity disrupts acid-base balance, impairs antioxidant and ammonia metabolism functions, induces metabolic alkalosis, and ultimately leads to growth inhibition.
outcome: 酸碱平衡、代谢功能与生长

quote: the acclimation of fish to alkaline stress is primarily mediated by physiological modifications in gill morphological characteristics and osmoregulatory functional capacities
statement: 鱼类对碱性胁迫的适应主要通过鳃形态特征和渗透调节功能的生理改变来介导。
text_zh: 鱼类对碱性胁迫的适应主要通过鳃形态特征和渗透调节功能的生理改变来介导。
text_en: Fish adaptation to alkaline stress is primarily mediated by physiological changes in gill morphological characteristics and osmoregulatory function.

quote: Paramisgurnus dabryanus and Lateolabrax maculatus responded to alkalinity stress with alterations in gill lamellar length and interlamellar distance
statement: 泥鳅和花鲈通过鳃丝长度和鳃间隔距离的改变来响应碱度胁迫。
text_zh: 泥鳅和花鲈通过鳃丝长度和鳃间隔距离的改变来响应碱度胁迫。
text_en: Loach and sea bass respond to alkalinity stress by changing gill filament length and interlamellar distance.

quote: alkalinity stress caused significant physiological stress in red tilapia (Oreochromis spp .), leading to alterations in gill structure and affecting antioxidant defense, metabolism, and ion balance
statement: 碱度胁迫在红罗非鱼中引起了显著的生理应激，导致鳃结构改变，并影响抗氧化防御、代谢和离子平衡。
text_zh: 碱度胁迫在红罗非鱼中引起了显著的生理应激，导致鳃结构改变，并影响抗氧化防御、代谢和离子平衡。
text_en: Alkalinity stress caused significant physiological stress in red tilapia, leading to gill structural changes and affecting antioxidant defense, metabolism, and ion balance.
outcome: 生理应激、鳃结构与代谢平衡

quote: the gills can adapt to alkalinity stress by altering the number and distribution of epithelial cells (EPCs), pillar cells (PCs), and mitochondria-rich cells (MRCs)
statement: 鳃可以通过改变上皮细胞（EPCs）、支柱细胞（PCs）和富含线粒体的细胞（MRCs）的数量和分布来适应碱度胁迫。
text_zh: 鳃可以通过改变上皮细胞（EPCs）、支柱细胞（PCs）和富含线粒体的细胞（MRCs）的数量和分布来适应碱度胁迫。
text_en: Gills can adapt to alkalinity stress by changing the number and distribution of epithelial cells (EPCs), pillar cells (PCs), and mitochondria-rich cells (MRCs).

quote:
In
the other views, the food selection of specimens
might be related to the abundance of resource users.
statement: 另一方面，个体的食物选择可能与资源使用者的丰度有关。
text_zh: 另一方面，个体的食物选择可能与资源使用者的丰度有关。
text_en: On the other hand, individual food choice may be related to the abundance of resource users.

quote:
In general, the feeding intensity estimated
based on a number of empty gut indicates seasonal
variation, with low in hot summer season because of
increasing
enzyme
activities
and
digestion
metabolism.
statement: 通常，基于空肠数量估计的摄食强度显示季节性变化，在炎热的夏季较低，原因是酶活性和消化代谢增加。
text_zh: 通常，基于空肠数量估计的摄食强度显示季节性变化，在炎热的夏季较低，原因是酶活性和消化代谢增加。
text_en: Typically, feeding intensity estimated based on the number of jejunums shows seasonal variation, being lower in hot summer due to increased enzyme activity and digestive metabolism.

The seasonal and size depend variation
in the feeding intensity might be related with the diet

statement: 摄食强度的季节性和大小依赖性变化可能与食物类型有关。
text_zh: 摄食强度的季节性和大小依赖性变化可能与食物类型有关。
text_en: Seasonal and size-dependent changes in feeding intensity may be related to food type.

quote: The CA20 group exhibited significantly lower moisture content than the control and CA40 groups, while the CA 40 group showed a significantly higher crude ash content than the control and CA20 groups
statement: CA20组的肌肉水分含量显著低于对照组和CA40组，而CA40组的粗灰分含量显著高于对照组和CA20组。
text_zh: CA20组的肌肉水分含量显著低于对照组和CA40组，而CA40组的粗灰分含量显著高于对照组和CA20组。
text_en: The muscle moisture content of the CA20 group was significantly lower than that of the control group and the CA40 group, while the crude ash content of the CA40 group was significantly higher than that of the control group and the CA20 group.

quote: most amino acids, including Asp, Glu, Arg, Met, Leu, Phe, and Tyr, were significantly reduced in the alkalinity-treated groups compared to the control group
statement: 与对照组相比，碱度处理组中大多数氨基酸（包括天冬氨酸、谷氨酸、精氨酸、蛋氨酸、亮氨酸、苯丙氨酸和酪氨酸）显著降低。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，碱度处理组中大多数氨基酸（包括天冬氨酸、谷氨酸、精氨酸、蛋氨酸、亮氨酸、苯丙氨酸和酪氨酸）显著降低。
text_en: Compared with the control group, most amino acids (including aspartic acid, glutamic acid, arginine, methionine, leucine, phenylalanine and tyrosine) were significantly decreased in the alkalinity treatment group.

quote: With increasing alkalinity, the levels of PUFA, n-6 PUFA, n-3 PUFA, eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA, C20:5n-3), and the sum of EPA and docosahexaenoic acid (DHA, C22:6n-3) were significantly reduced
statement: 随着碱度增加，多不饱和脂肪酸（PUFA）、n-6 PUFA、n-3 PUFA、二十碳五烯酸（EPA）以及EPA和二十二碳六烯酸（DHA）的总和显著降低。
text_zh: 随着碱度增加，多不饱和脂肪酸（PUFA）、n-6 PUFA、n-3 PUFA、二十碳五烯酸（EPA）以及EPA和二十二碳六烯酸（DHA）的总和显著降低。
text_en: As alkalinity increased, polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFA), n-6 PUFA, n-3 PUFA, eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA), and the sum of EPA and docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) significantly decreased.

quote: Compared to the control group, both the CA20 and CA40 groups exhibited marked alterations in muscle tissue structure and fiber density (Figure 8).
statement: 与对照组相比，CA20和CA40组的肌肉组织结构和纤维密度表现出显著改变。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，CA20和CA40组的肌肉组织结构和纤维密度表现出显著改变。
text_en: Compared with the control group, the muscle tissue structure and fiber density of the CA20 and CA40 groups showed significant changes.

quote: In the control group, muscle fibers were tightly packed and well-organized (Figure 8 A), whereas increasing alkalinity led to enlarged inter-fiber spacing, irregular fiber arrangement, and a looser structure (Figure 8 A).
statement: 随着碱度增加，肌纤维间距增大，排列不规则，结构变得松散。
text_zh: 随着碱度增加，肌纤维间距增大，排列不规则，结构变得松散。
text_en: As alkalinity increases, the distance between muscle fibers widens, their arrangement becomes irregular, and the structure becomes loose.

quote: Both alkalinity-treated groups showed significantly reduced muscle fiber long diameter and density (Figure 8 B; p
statement: 两个碱度处理组的肌纤维长径和密度均显著降低。
text_zh: 两个碱度处理组的肌纤维长径和密度均显著降低。
text_en: The muscle fiber length and density in both alkalinity treatment groups were significantly reduced.

quote: In contrast, alkalinity stress induced distinct structural alterations (Figure 5 B,C,E,F), including shortened and thickened lamellae (Figure 5 G,H) and widened interlamellar spacing (Figure 5 I).
statement: 相比之下，碱度胁迫诱导了明显的结构改变，包括鳃小片变短变厚以及鳃小片间距加宽。
text_zh: 相比之下，碱度胁迫诱导了明显的结构改变，包括鳃小片变短变厚以及鳃小片间距加宽。
text_en: In contrast, alkalinity stress induced obvious structural changes, including shortened and thickened gill lamellae and widened spacing between gill lamellae.

quote: Furthermore, with increasing alkalinity, the CA20 group exhibited vasodilation and rupture of gill filament vascular cells (Figure 5 B,E).
statement: 此外，随着碱度的增加，CA20组表现出血管舒张和鳃丝血管细胞破裂。
text_zh: 此外，随着碱度的增加，CA20组表现出血管舒张和鳃丝血管细胞破裂。
text_en: In addition, with increasing alkalinity, the CA20 group showed vasodilation and rupture of gill filament vascular cells.

quote: The CA40 group showed similar symptoms, accompanied by EPC detachment, an increased number of MRCs, and swelling at the distal ends of the gill lamellae (Figure 5 C,F).
statement: CA40组表现出类似的症状，伴随有EPC脱落、MRC数量增加以及鳃小片远端肿胀。
text_zh: CA40组表现出类似的症状，伴随有EPC脱落、MRC数量增加以及鳃小片远端肿胀。
text_en: The CA40 group exhibited similar symptoms, accompanied by EPC detachment, an increase in MRC number, and swelling of the distal parts of the gill lamellae.
outcome: 鳃上皮细胞损伤与炎症反应

quote: Table 3 Muscle amino acid contents (g/100 g dry weight) in Qihe crucian carp Carassius carassius after 60 d alkalinity stress.
statement: 表3显示了齐河鲫鱼在60天碱度胁迫后的肌肉氨基酸含量。
text_zh: 表3显示了齐河鲫鱼在60天碱度胁迫后的肌肉氨基酸含量。
text_en: Table 3 shows the muscle amino acid content of Qihe crucian carp after 60 days of alkalinity stress.

statement: 随着碱度处理组别从对照到CA40，总氨基酸（TAA）、必需氨基酸（EAA）、非必需氨基酸（NEAA）和呈味氨基酸（DAA）的含量数值均呈现下降趋势。
text_zh: 随着碱度处理组别从对照到CA40，总氨基酸（TAA）、必需氨基酸（EAA）、非必需氨基酸（NEAA）和呈味氨基酸（DAA）的含量数值均呈现下降趋势。
text_en: As the alkalinity treatment groups progressed from control to CA40, the content values of total amino acids (TAA), essential amino acids (EAA), non-essential amino acids (NEAA), and flavor amino acids (DAA) all showed a decreasing trend.

quote: Alkalinity represents a major environmental stressor for freshwater fish, as it can induce respiratory and metabolic alkalosis, severely compromising key physiological processes such as growth, survival, and reproduction
statement: 碱度是淡水鱼的主要环境胁迫因子，可诱导呼吸性和代谢性碱中毒，严重损害生长、存活和繁殖等关键生理过程。
text_zh: 碱度是淡水鱼的主要环境胁迫因子，可诱导呼吸性和代谢性碱中毒，严重损害生长、存活和繁殖等关键生理过程。
text_en: Alkalinity is a major environmental stress factor for freshwater fish, which can induce respiratory and metabolic alkalosis, severely impairing key physiological processes such as growth, survival, and reproduction.

quote: The survival capability of aquatic animals in saline-alkaline water is the most critical indicator for evaluating their potential as candidate species for saline-alkaline water aquaculture
statement: 水生动物在盐碱水中的存活能力是评估其作为盐碱水养殖候选物种潜力的最关键指标。
text_zh: 水生动物在盐碱水中的存活能力是评估其作为盐碱水养殖候选物种潜力的最关键指标。
text_en: The survival ability of aquatic animals in saline-alkaline water is the most critical indicator for evaluating their potential as candidate species for saline-alkaline water aquaculture.

quote: juvenile silver crucian carp exposed to acute alkalinity stress at 30 mmol/L all died within 48 h
statement: 暴露于30 mmol/L急性碱度胁迫下的银鲫幼鱼在48小时内全部死亡。
text_zh: 暴露于30 mmol/L急性碱度胁迫下的银鲫幼鱼在48小时内全部死亡。
text_en: Juvenile gibel carp exposed to acute alkalinity stress at 30 mmol/L died within 48 hours.

quote: 30 mmol/L alkalinity significantly reduced growth performance and feed efficiency in grass carp (C. idella) juveniles and altered gill lamellar structure
statement: 30 mmol/L的碱度显著降低了草鱼幼鱼的生长性能和饲料效率，并改变了鳃小片结构。
text_zh: 30 mmol/L的碱度显著降低了草鱼幼鱼的生长性能和饲料效率，并改变了鳃小片结构。
text_en: 30 mmol/L alkalinity significantly reduced the growth performance and feed efficiency of grass carp juveniles, and altered gill lamellae structure.
outcome: 生长性能、饲料效率、鳃部结构

quote: largemouth bass exposed to an alkalinity environment of 28 mmol/L did not affect their survival
statement: 暴露于28 mmol/L碱度环境中的大口黑鲈其存活率未受影响。
text_zh: 暴露于28 mmol/L碱度环境中的大口黑鲈其存活率未受影响。
text_en: The survival rate of largemouth bass exposed to an alkalinity environment of 28 mmol/L was not affected.

quote: Qihe crucian carp exhibited 100% SR after 60 d of exposure to 20 and 40 mmol/L alkalinities, indicating a strong tolerance to alkalinity
statement: 齐河鲫鱼在暴露于20和40 mmol/L碱度60天后表现出100%的存活率，表明其对碱度具有很强的耐受性。
text_zh: 齐河鲫鱼在暴露于20和40 mmol/L碱度60天后表现出100%的存活率，表明其对碱度具有很强的耐受性。
text_en: Qihou crucian carp showed a 100% survival rate after being exposed to alkalinity of 20 and 40 mmol/L for 60 days, indicating strong tolerance to alkalinity.

quote: This study examined changes in the external morphology in Qihe crucian carp under alkalinity stress.
statement: 本研究考察了碱性胁迫下齐河鲫外部形态的变化。
text_zh: 本研究考察了碱性胁迫下齐河鲫外部形态的变化。
text_en: This study examined changes in the external morphology of Qihe crucian carp under alkaline stress.

quote: This phenomenon may stem from the catabolism of proteins and fats under alkaline stress to meet energy demands [ 14 ].
statement: 这种现象可能源于在碱性胁迫下蛋白质和脂肪的分解代谢以满足能量需求。
text_zh: 这种现象可能源于在碱性胁迫下蛋白质和脂肪的分解代谢以满足能量需求。
text_en: This phenomenon may stem from the catabolism of proteins and fats to meet energy demands under alkaline stress.

quote: In the present study, Qihe crucian carp displayed shortened lamellae, thickened filaments, and widened interlamellar spacing.
statement: 在本研究中，齐河鲫表现出鳃小片缩短、鳃丝增厚和鳃小片间距加宽。
text_zh: 在本研究中，齐河鲫表现出鳃小片缩短、鳃丝增厚和鳃小片间距加宽。
text_en: In this study, Qihe crucian carp showed shortened gill lamellae, thickened gill filaments, and widened spacing between gill lamellae.

quote: In addition, our study found that the alkalinity-treated groups exhibited vasodilation in the gill lamellae.
statement: 此外，我们的研究发现碱度处理组在鳃小片中表现出血管舒张。
text_zh: 此外，我们的研究发现碱度处理组在鳃小片中表现出血管舒张。
text_en: In addition, our study found that the alkalinity treatment group showed vasodilation in the gill lamellae.

quote: When facing environmental alkalinity stress, Qihe crucian carp may consume amino acids as a direct energy source to maintain physiological functions, thereby declining amino acid levels in tissues [ 53 ].
statement: 面对环境碱度胁迫时，齐河鲫鱼可能消耗氨基酸作为直接能量来源以维持生理功能，从而导致组织中氨基酸水平下降。
text_zh: 面对环境碱度胁迫时，齐河鲫鱼可能消耗氨基酸作为直接能量来源以维持生理功能，从而导致组织中氨基酸水平下降。
text_en: When facing environmental alkalinity stress, Qihe crucian carp may consume amino acids as a direct energy source to maintain physiological functions, leading to decreased amino acid levels in tissues.

quote: Furthermore, the alkalinity stress led to a significant decrease in the content of DAA in the muscles of Qihe crucian carp, indicating that the flavor of the muscles might be affected in an alkaline water environment [ 23 ].
statement: 碱度胁迫导致齐河鲫鱼肌肉中DAA含量显著降低，表明在碱性水环境中肌肉风味可能受到影响。
text_zh: 碱度胁迫导致齐河鲫鱼肌肉中DAA含量显著降低，表明在碱性水环境中肌肉风味可能受到影响。
text_en: Alkalinity stress caused a significant decrease in DAA content in the muscle of Qihe crucian carp, indicating that muscle flavor may be affected in an alkaline water environment.

quote: Although the TAA and NEAA decreased progressively under alkalinity stress, their ratios remained within the ideal model recommended by WHO/FAO for protein nutrition (EAA/TAA = 40.00%, EAA/NEAA > 60.00%), indicating that Qihe crucian carp under alkalinity stress remains a high-quality protein source [ 54 ].
statement: 尽管在碱度胁迫下TAA和NEAA逐渐减少，但其比例保持在WHO/FAO推荐的蛋白质营养理想模型范围内，表明碱度胁迫下的齐河鲫鱼仍是一种优质蛋白来源。
text_zh: 尽管在碱度胁迫下TAA和NEAA逐渐减少，但其比例保持在WHO/FAO推荐的蛋白质营养理想模型范围内，表明碱度胁迫下的齐河鲫鱼仍是一种优质蛋白来源。
text_en: Although TAA and NEAA gradually decreased under alkalinity stress, their ratio remained within the range of the WHO/FAO recommended ideal protein nutrition model, indicating that Qihe crucian carp under alkalinity stress is still a high-quality protein source.

quote: Although alkalinity stress significantly reduced total PUFA, n-3 PUFA, and n-6 PUFA contents in the muscle of Qihe crucian carp, the n-3/n-6 ratios in all experimental groups (0.31, 0.38, 0.36, respectively) exceeded the FAO/WHO recommended minimum of 0.2 for health benefits [ 56 ].
statement: 虽然碱度胁迫显著降低了齐河鲫鱼肌肉中的总PUFA、n-3 PUFA和n-6 PUFA含量，但所有实验组的n-3/n-6比值均超过了FAO/WHO推荐的健康益处最低值0.2。
text_zh: 虽然碱度胁迫显著降低了齐河鲫鱼肌肉中的总PUFA、n-3 PUFA和n-6 PUFA含量，但所有实验组的n-3/n-6比值均超过了FAO/WHO推荐的健康益处最低值0.2。
text_en: Although alkalinity stress significantly reduced the total PUFA, n-3 PUFA, and n-6 PUFA contents in the muscle of Qihe crucian carp, the n-3/n-6 ratio in all experimental groups exceeded the minimum value of 0.2 recommended by FAO/WHO for health benefits.

quote: Compared to the control group, the CA40 group demonstrated an increase in centrifugal loss and drip loss, along with a decrease in pH value.
statement: 与对照组相比，CA40组表现出离心损失和滴水损失增加，以及pH值降低。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，CA40组表现出离心损失和滴水损失增加，以及pH值降低。
text_en: Compared with the control group, the CA40 group showed increased centrifugal loss and drip loss, as well as decreased pH.

quote: Based on previous studies, the observed growth suppression under high-alkalinity conditions can be attributed to several potential mechanisms. Firstly, increased alkalinity may elevate the energy expenditure required for osmoregulation and acid–base balance, thereby reducing the energy available for growth metabolism and ultimately impairing growth performance [ 35 , 38 ].
statement: 根据先前的研究，在高碱度条件下观察到的生长抑制可归因于几种潜在机制。首先，增加的碱度可能会提高渗透调节和酸碱平衡所需的能量消耗，从而减少用于生长代谢的能量，最终损害生长性能。
text_zh: 根据先前的研究，在高碱度条件下观察到的生长抑制可归因于几种潜在机制。首先，增加的碱度可能会提高渗透调节和酸碱平衡所需的能量消耗，从而减少用于生长代谢的能量，最终损害生长性能。
text_en: According to previous studies, the growth inhibition observed under high alkalinity conditions can be attributed to several potential mechanisms. First, increased alkalinity may raise the energy expenditure required for osmoregulation and acid-base balance, thereby reducing the energy available for growth metabolism and ultimately impairing growth performance.

quote: Additionally, structural damage to the intestine and liver from alkalinity stress may adversely affect their physiological function, leading to reduced nutrient absorption
statement: 碱度胁迫造成的肠道和肝脏结构损伤可能影响其生理功能，导致营养吸收减少。
text_zh: 碱度胁迫造成的肠道和肝脏结构损伤可能影响其生理功能，导致营养吸收减少。
text_en: Structural damage to the intestine and liver caused by alkalinity stress may affect their physiological functions, leading to reduced nutrient absorption.

quote: Furthermore, it was speculated that alterations in the gut microbiota composition may be one of the potential factors contributing to the reduced feed efficiency observed in this study
statement: 推测肠道微生物群组成的改变可能是导致本研究中观察到的饲料效率降低的潜在因素之一。
text_zh: 推测肠道微生物群组成的改变可能是导致本研究中观察到的饲料效率降低的潜在因素之一。
text_en: It is speculated that changes in gut microbiota composition may be one of the potential factors leading to the reduced feed efficiency observed in this study.

quote: Under alkaline conditions, fish need to activate ATPase activities involved in ion regulation and acid–base balance, thereby incurring energetic costs and diminishing the energy available for growth
statement: 在碱性条件下，鱼类需要激活参与离子调节和酸碱平衡的ATP酶活性，从而产生能量成本并减少可用于生长的能量。
text_zh: 在碱性条件下，鱼类需要激活参与离子调节和酸碱平衡的ATP酶活性，从而产生能量成本并减少可用于生长的能量。
text_en: Under alkaline conditions, fish need to activate ATPase activity involved in ion regulation and acid-base balance, thereby generating an energy cost and reducing the energy available for growth.

quote: Our observations of increased NKA activity and HSI, coupled with the decrease in CF in the CA20 and CA 40 groups, supported this energy reallocation hypothesis.
statement: CA20和CA40组中NKA活性和肝体指数(HSI)的增加以及肥满度(CF)的降低支持了能量重新分配的假设。
text_zh: CA20和CA40组中NKA活性和肝体指数(HSI)的增加以及肥满度(CF)的降低支持了能量重新分配的假设。
text_en: The increase in NKA activity and hepatosomatic index (HSI) and the decrease in condition factor (CF) in the CA20 and CA40 groups support the hypothesis of energy reallocation.

quote: Omics approaches, such as transcriptomics and metabolomics, should also be employed to further elucidate the molecular mechanisms through which alkalinity stress affects the growth and nutritional quality of fish.
statement: 转录组学和代谢组学等组学方法应被用于阐明碱度胁迫影响鱼类生长和营养品质的分子机制。
text_zh: 转录组学和代谢组学等组学方法应被用于阐明碱度胁迫影响鱼类生长和营养品质的分子机制。
text_en: Omics methods such as transcriptomics and metabolomics should be used to elucidate the molecular mechanisms by which alkalinity stress affects fish growth and nutritional quality.

quote: Moreover, it is necessary to develop economically effective feed additives to alleviate the adverse effects of alkalinity stress on the growth performance and muscle quality of Qihe crucian carp.
statement: 有必要开发经济有效的饲料添加剂，以缓解碱度胁迫对齐河鲫鱼生长性能和肌肉品质的不利影响。
text_zh: 有必要开发经济有效的饲料添加剂，以缓解碱度胁迫对齐河鲫鱼生长性能和肌肉品质的不利影响。
text_en: It is necessary to develop cost-effective feed additives to alleviate the adverse effects of alkalinity stress on the growth performance and muscle quality of Carassius auratus gibelio.

quote: However, alkalinity stress significantly impaired both growth performance and feed efficiency.
statement: 然而，碱度胁迫显著损害了生长性能和饲料效率。
text_zh: 然而，碱度胁迫显著损害了生长性能和饲料效率。
text_en: However, alkalinity stress significantly impaired growth performance and feed efficiency.

quote: The alkalinity ≤ 40 mmol/L did not affect the SR.
statement: 碱度≤40 mmol/L不影响存活率。
text_zh: 碱度≤40 mmol/L不影响存活率。
text_en: Alkalinity ≤40 mmol/L does not affect survival rate.

quote: Qihe crucian carp may adapt to the alkalinity stress through adjustments in serum ion concentrations (Na + and Ca 2+), gill enzyme activities (NKA and CMA), and gill histology.
statement: 齐河鲫鱼可能通过调节血清离子浓度、鳃酶活性和鳃组织学来适应碱度胁迫。
text_zh: 齐河鲫鱼可能通过调节血清离子浓度、鳃酶活性和鳃组织学来适应碱度胁迫。
text_en: Qihe crucian carp may adapt to alkalinity stress by regulating serum ion concentrations, gill enzyme activity, and gill histology.

quote: Alterations in muscle nutritional components (amino acids, fatty acids), physical properties, and microstructure induced by alkalinity stress ultimately led to a reduction in overall muscle nutritional quality.
statement: 碱度胁迫诱导的肌肉营养成分、物理特性和微观结构的改变最终导致整体肌肉营养质量下降。
text_zh: 碱度胁迫诱导的肌肉营养成分、物理特性和微观结构的改变最终导致整体肌肉营养质量下降。
text_en: Changes in muscle nutritional composition, physical properties, and microstructure induced by alkalinity stress ultimately lead to a decline in overall muscle nutritional quality.

quote: Considering both growth performance and muscle quality, the suitable alkalinity for the practical saline-alkaline water aquaculture of Qihe crucian carp should be controlled below 20 mmol/L.
statement: 综合考虑生长性能和肌肉品质，齐河鲫鱼盐碱水养殖的适宜碱度应控制在20 mmol/L以下。
text_zh: 综合考虑生长性能和肌肉品质，齐河鲫鱼盐碱水养殖的适宜碱度应控制在20 mmol/L以下。
text_en: Considering both growth performance and muscle quality, the suitable alkalinity for Qihé crucian carp farming in saline-alkaline water should be controlled below 20 mmol/L.

quote: Acute alkalinity stress induces functional damage and alters immune metabolic pathways in the gill tissue of spotted scat (Scatophagus argus)
statement: 急性碱度胁迫会导致斑点星鲷鳃组织的功能损伤并改变免疫代谢途径。
text_zh: 急性碱度胁迫会导致斑点星鲷鳃组织的功能损伤并改变免疫代谢途径。
text_en: Acute alkalinity stress causes functional damage to the gill tissue of spotted star bream and alters immune metabolic pathways.
outcome: 鳃组织功能与免疫代谢

quote: Alkaline water improves the growth and antioxidant responses of pacu juveniles (Piaractus mesopotamicus)
statement: 碱性水改善了短盖巨脂鲤幼鱼的生长和抗氧化反应。
text_zh: 碱性水改善了短盖巨脂鲤幼鱼的生长和抗氧化反应。
text_en: Alkaline water improved the growth and antioxidant response of juvenile Colossoma macropomum.

quote: Growth performance, antioxidant capacity, intestinal microbiota, and metabolomics analysis of Nile tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) under carbonate alkalinity stress.
statement: 研究了碳酸盐碱度胁迫下尼罗罗非鱼的生长性能、抗氧化能力、肠道菌群及代谢组学。
text_zh: 研究了碳酸盐碱度胁迫下尼罗罗非鱼的生长性能、抗氧化能力、肠道菌群及代谢组学。
text_en: Growth performance, antioxidant capacity, gut microbiota, and metabolomics of Nile tilapia under carbonate alkalinity stress were studied.
outcome: 生长性能、抗氧化能力、肠道菌群与代谢

quote: Exploring the metabolic biomarkers and pathway changes in crucian under carbonate alkalinity exposure using high-throughput metabolomics analysis based on UPLC-ESI-QTOF-MS.
statement: 利用基于UPLC-ESI-QTOF-MS的高通量代谢组学分析探索了碳酸盐碱度暴露下鲫鱼体内的代谢生物标志物和通路变化。
text_zh: 利用基于UPLC-ESI-QTOF-MS的高通量代谢组学分析探索了碳酸盐碱度暴露下鲫鱼体内的代谢生物标志物和通路变化。
text_en: High-throughput metabolomics analysis based on UPLC-ESI-QTOF-MS was used to explore metabolic biomarkers and pathway changes in crucian carp under carbonate alkalinity exposure.
outcome: 代谢生物标志物与通路

quote: Examination of the relationship of carbonate alkalinity stress and ammonia metabolism disorder-mediated apoptosis in the Chinese mitten crab, Eriocheir sinensis: Potential involvement of the ROS/MAPK signaling pathway.
statement: 考察了中华绒螯蟹中碳酸盐碱度胁迫与氨代谢紊乱介导的细胞凋亡之间的关系，涉及ROS/MAPK信号通路。
text_zh: 考察了中华绒螯蟹中碳酸盐碱度胁迫与氨代谢紊乱介导的细胞凋亡之间的关系，涉及ROS/MAPK信号通路。
text_en: The relationship between carbonate alkalinity stress and apoptosis mediated by ammonia metabolism disorder in Chinese mitten crab was investigated, involving the ROS/MAPK signaling pathway.
outcome: 氨代谢紊乱与细胞凋亡

quote: This finding indicated the existence of the dose effect of alkalinity stress in Qihe crucian carp.
statement: 这一发现表明齐河鲫鱼中存在碱度胁迫的剂量效应。
text_zh: 这一发现表明齐河鲫鱼中存在碱度胁迫的剂量效应。
text_en: This finding indicates a dose effect of alkalinity stress in Qihe crucian carp.

quote: For Qihe crucian carp, 40 mmol/L alkalinity may represent a severe environmental challenge, causing it to expend a large amount of energy to regulate osmotic pressure, and during this process, the fat and protein in the muscle may be consumed for energy supply [ 28 , 38 ].
statement: 对于齐河鲫鱼而言，40 mmol/L的碱度可能代表严重的环境挑战，导致其消耗大量能量调节渗透压，在此过程中，肌肉中的脂肪和蛋白质可能被消耗以供应能量。
text_zh: 对于齐河鲫鱼而言，40 mmol/L的碱度可能代表严重的环境挑战，导致其消耗大量能量调节渗透压，在此过程中，肌肉中的脂肪和蛋白质可能被消耗以供应能量。
text_en: For Qihe crucian carp, an alkalinity of 40 mmol/L may represent a severe environmental challenge, causing them to consume large amounts of energy for osmoregulation, during which fat and protein in the muscles may be consumed to supply energy.
outcome: 能量代谢与渗透压调节

quote: In response to environmental stress, free amino acids contribute to osmotic regulation, thereby directly impacting the amino acid profile in muscle tissue [ 26 ].
statement: 在应对环境胁迫时，游离氨基酸有助于渗透调节，从而直接影响肌肉组织中的氨基酸谱。
text_zh: 在应对环境胁迫时，游离氨基酸有助于渗透调节，从而直接影响肌肉组织中的氨基酸谱。
text_en: When responding to environmental stress, free amino acids contribute to osmoregulation, thereby directly affecting the amino acid profile in muscle tissue.

quote: This finding differed from the increased TAA content observed in red drum and largemouth bass under low saline-alkaline water [ 23 , 25 ].
statement: 这一发现不同于在低盐碱水中观察到的红鼓鱼和大口黑鲈TAA含量增加的情况。
text_zh: 这一发现不同于在低盐碱水中观察到的红鼓鱼和大口黑鲈TAA含量增加的情况。
text_en: This finding differs from the increased TAA content observed in red drum and largemouth bass in low saline-alkaline water.
counterevidence: 与本研究中齐河鲫鱼的结果相反

quote: Structurally, alkalinity stress was found to significantly reduce muscle fiber diameter and cross-sectional area, while increasing muscle fiber density in largemouth bass [ 23 ].
statement: 碱性胁迫显著降低了大口黑鲈的肌纤维直径和横截面积，同时增加了肌纤维密度。
text_zh: 碱性胁迫显著降低了大口黑鲈的肌纤维直径和横截面积，同时增加了肌纤维密度。
text_en: Alkaline stress significantly reduced the muscle fiber diameter and cross-sectional area of largemouth bass, while increasing muscle fiber density.

quote: The results of this study indicated that alkalinity stress significantly reduced the muscle hardness of Qihe crucian carp, which may be primarily due to a decrease in muscle fiber density.
statement: 本研究结果表明，碱性胁迫显著降低了齐河鲫鱼的肌肉硬度，这可能主要归因于肌纤维密度的降低。
text_zh: 本研究结果表明，碱性胁迫显著降低了齐河鲫鱼的肌肉硬度，这可能主要归因于肌纤维密度的降低。
text_en: The results of this study indicate that alkaline stress significantly reduced the muscle hardness of Qihe crucian carp, which may be mainly attributed to a decrease in muscle fiber density.

quote: Structurally, alkalinity stress led to a reduction in both the long diameter and density of muscle fibers in Qihe crucian carp.
statement: 在结构上，碱性胁迫导致齐河鲫鱼的肌纤维长径和密度均降低。
text_zh: 在结构上，碱性胁迫导致齐河鲫鱼的肌纤维长径和密度均降低。
text_en: Structurally, alkaline stress led to a decrease in both the long diameter and density of muscle fibers in Qihe crucian carp.

quote: In summary, alkalinity stress induced modifications in the physical and structural characteristics of Qihe crucian carp muscle, thereby compromising its quality.
statement: 总之，碱性胁迫诱导了齐河鲫鱼肌肉物理和结构特性的改变，从而损害了其品质。
text_zh: 总之，碱性胁迫诱导了齐河鲫鱼肌肉物理和结构特性的改变，从而损害了其品质。
text_en: In conclusion, alkaline stress induced changes in the physical and structural properties of Qihe crucian carp muscle, thereby impairing its quality.

quote: While our study confirmed the effects of alkalinity stress on the growth performance and muscle quality of Qihe crucian carp, it was important to acknowledge that the complex ionic composition of natural saline-alkaline water was not fully replicated in our experimental system.
statement: 虽然本研究证实了碱性胁迫对齐河鲫鱼生长性能和肌肉品质的影响，但必须承认实验系统未能完全复制天然盐碱水的复杂离子组成。
text_zh: 虽然本研究证实了碱性胁迫对齐河鲫鱼生长性能和肌肉品质的影响，但必须承认实验系统未能完全复制天然盐碱水的复杂离子组成。
text_en: Although this study confirmed the effects of alkaline stress on the growth performance and muscle quality of Carassius auratus gibelio, it must be acknowledged that the experimental system did not fully replicate the complex ionic composition of natural saline-alkaline water.
limitations: 实验系统未能完全复制天然盐碱水的复杂离子组成

quote: The use of CyHV-2 LAMP assay to detect CyHV-2 in clinical specimens was evaluated by testing a total of 5 CyHV-2 infected and 5 healthy fish, which were tested previously by nested PCR.
statement: 通过检测5条感染CyHV-2的鱼和5条健康鱼（此前已通过巢式PCR检测）来评估LAMP检测法在临床样本中检测CyHV-2的应用。
text_zh: 通过检测5条感染CyHV-2的鱼和5条健康鱼（此前已通过巢式PCR检测）来评估LAMP检测法在临床样本中检测CyHV-2的应用。
text_en: The application of the LAMP assay for detecting CyHV-2 in clinical samples was evaluated by testing 5 fish infected with CyHV-2 and 5 healthy fish (previously detected by nested PCR).

quote: This indicated that alkalinity stress compromised the water-holding capacity of Qihe crucian carp muscle, consequently diminishing its quality.
statement: 这表明碱性胁迫损害了齐河鲫鱼肌肉的持水能力，从而降低了其品质。
text_zh: 这表明碱性胁迫损害了齐河鲫鱼肌肉的持水能力，从而降低了其品质。
text_en: This indicates that alkalinity stress impaired the water-holding capacity of Qihe crucian carp muscle, thereby reducing its quality.

quote: Our results revealed that both water-holding capacity and muscle fiber density of Qihe crucian carp significantly decreased under alkalinity stress.
statement: 我们的结果显示，在碱性胁迫下，齐河鲫鱼的持水能力和肌纤维密度均显著下降。
text_zh: 我们的结果显示，在碱性胁迫下，齐河鲫鱼的持水能力和肌纤维密度均显著下降。
text_en: Our results showed that under alkalinity stress, the water-holding capacity and muscle fiber density of Qihe crucian carp decreased significantly.

quote: Therefore, we speculated that the alkalinity stress reduced the muscle fiber density of Qihe crucian carp, leading to a looser grid structure between muscle cells.
statement: 因此，我们推测碱性胁迫降低了齐河鲫鱼的肌纤维密度，导致肌肉细胞间的网格结构变得松散。
text_zh: 因此，我们推测碱性胁迫降低了齐河鲫鱼的肌纤维密度，导致肌肉细胞间的网格结构变得松散。
text_en: Therefore, we hypothesize that alkalinity stress reduced the muscle fiber density of Qihe crucian carp, leading to a looser grid structure between muscle cells.

quote: A previous study on largemouth bass reported that alkalinity stress significantly enhanced the textural properties, including the chewiness, cohesiveness, resilience, hardness and gumminess [ 23 ].
statement: 先前关于大口黑鲈的研究报道，碱性胁迫显著增强了包括咀嚼性、内聚性、弹性、硬度和胶着性在内的质地特性。
text_zh: 先前关于大口黑鲈的研究报道，碱性胁迫显著增强了包括咀嚼性、内聚性、弹性、硬度和胶着性在内的质地特性。
text_en: Previous studies on largemouth bass reported that alkalinity stress significantly enhanced texture properties including chewiness, cohesiveness, springiness, hardness, and gumminess.

quote: Recently, an epizootic with severe mortality has emerged in cultured gibel carp in China and caused huge economic loss.
statement: 近期中国养殖的鲫鱼爆发了一种导致严重死亡的流行病，并造成了巨大的经济损失。
text_zh: 近期中国养殖的鲫鱼爆发了一种导致严重死亡的流行病，并造成了巨大的经济损失。
text_en: Recently, a severe epidemic causing high mortality broke out among farmed crucian carp in China, resulting in huge economic losses.

quote: In this study, a highly sensitive and specific diagnostic method based on the loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) for CyHV-2 detection in gibel carp was developed following cloning and sequencing of the DNA helicase gene of CyHV-2.
statement: 本研究在克隆和测序CyHV-2的DNA解旋酶基因后，开发了一种基于环介导等温扩增（LAMP）的高灵敏度、高特异性检测方法，用于检测鲫鱼中的CyHV-2。
text_zh: 本研究在克隆和测序CyHV-2的DNA解旋酶基因后，开发了一种基于环介导等温扩增（LAMP）的高灵敏度、高特异性检测方法，用于检测鲫鱼中的CyHV-2。
text_en: After cloning and sequencing the DNA helicase gene of CyHV-2, this study developed a high-sensitivity, high-specificity detection method based on loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) for detecting CyHV-2 in crucian carp.

quote: This study represents the first report of LAMP assay for CyHV-2 detection in cultured gibel carp, which has great potential use in both laboratory and field diagnosis of the disease.
statement: 这是首次报道将LAMP检测法用于养殖鲫鱼的CyHV-2检测，该技术在实验室和田间疾病诊断中具有巨大潜力。
text_zh: 这是首次报道将LAMP检测法用于养殖鲫鱼的CyHV-2检测，该技术在实验室和田间疾病诊断中具有巨大潜力。
text_en: This is the first report of using the LAMP detection method for CyHV-2 detection in farmed crucian carp, and this technology has great potential in laboratory and field disease diagnosis.

quote: In the present study, NKA activity in gills of Qihe crucian carp increased significantly with rising alkalinity
statement: 在本研究中，随着碱度升高，齐河鲫鱼鳃部的Na+/K+-ATPase活性显著增加。
text_zh: 在本研究中，随着碱度升高，齐河鲫鱼鳃部的Na+/K+-ATPase活性显著增加。
text_en: In this study, as alkalinity increased, the Na+/K+-ATPase activity in the gills of Qihe crucian carp significantly increased.

quote: the concentrations of K + , Mg 2+ , Cl − , and Ca 2+ in the alkalinity-treated groups remained relatively stable, whereas the concentration of Na + increased significantly
statement: 与对照组相比，碱度处理组血清中K+、Mg2+、Cl-和Ca2+浓度保持相对稳定，而Na+浓度显著增加。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，碱度处理组血清中K+、Mg2+、Cl-和Ca2+浓度保持相对稳定，而Na+浓度显著增加。
text_en: Compared with the control group, serum K+, Mg2+, Cl-, and Ca2+ concentrations remained relatively stable in the alkalinity treatment group, while Na+ concentration increased significantly.

quote: This suggested that in response to chronic alkalinity stress, Qihe crucian carp may maintain a higher Na + concentration to regulate osmotic balance by upregulating NKA activity
statement: 这表明在慢性碱度胁迫下，齐河鲫可能通过上调NKA活性来维持较高的Na+浓度以调节渗透平衡。
text_zh: 这表明在慢性碱度胁迫下，齐河鲫可能通过上调NKA活性来维持较高的Na+浓度以调节渗透平衡。
text_en: This suggests that under chronic alkalinity stress, Qihou crucian carp may maintain higher Na+ concentrations to regulate osmotic balance by upregulating NKA activity.

quote: CMA activity in gills of Qihe crucian carp significantly declined under high-alkalinity conditions
statement: 在高碱度条件下，齐河鲫鳃中的Ca2+-ATP酶（CMA）活性显著下降。
text_zh: 在高碱度条件下，齐河鲫鳃中的Ca2+-ATP酶（CMA）活性显著下降。
text_en: Under high alkalinity conditions, the Ca2+-ATPase (CMA) activity in the gills of Qihe crucian carp decreased significantly.

quote: serum Ca 2+ concentrations showed no significant differences between the alkalinity-treated groups and the control group
statement: 碱度处理组与对照组之间的血清Ca2+浓度无显著差异。
text_zh: 碱度处理组与对照组之间的血清Ca2+浓度无显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference in serum Ca2+ concentration between the alkalinity treatment group and the control group.

quote: Alkalinity stress not only impacts growth but also modifies muscle quality
statement: 碱度胁迫不仅影响生长，还会改变肌肉品质。
text_zh: 碱度胁迫不仅影响生长，还会改变肌肉品质。
text_en: Alkalinity stress not only affects growth, but also changes muscle quality.

quote: In alkaline water, HCO 3 − and CO 3 2− directly act on the gill epidermal cells (MRCs, PVCs, MCs, etc.), affecting their gas and ion exchange functions, interfering with ammonia nitrogen metabolism and acid–base balance, and causing ammonia poisoning and alkalosis in the fish body
statement: 在碱性水中，HCO3-和CO32-直接作用于鳃表皮细胞，影响其气体和离子交换功能，干扰氨氮代谢和酸碱平衡，导致鱼体氨中毒和碱中毒。
text_zh: 在碱性水中，HCO3-和CO32-直接作用于鳃表皮细胞，影响其气体和离子交换功能，干扰氨氮代谢和酸碱平衡，导致鱼体氨中毒和碱中毒。
text_en: In alkaline water, HCO3- and CO32- directly act on the gill epidermal cells, affecting their gas and ion exchange functions, interfering with ammonia nitrogen metabolism and acid-base balance, leading to ammonia poisoning and alkalosis in fish.
outcome: 生理机能受损（气体/离子交换、代谢、酸碱平衡）

quote: Studies on L. waleckii reported lamellar damage, epithelial detachment, and reduced MCs/PVCs under high alkalinity
statement: 关于L. waleckii的研究报道了在高碱度下出现鳃片损伤、上皮脱落以及黏液细胞/铺路石细胞减少。
text_zh: 关于L. waleckii的研究报道了在高碱度下出现鳃片损伤、上皮脱落以及黏液细胞/铺路石细胞减少。
text_en: Studies on L. waleckii reported gill lamella damage, epithelial detachment, and a reduction in mucous cells/pavement cells under high alkalinity.

quote: In the present study, we observed epithelial shedding and MRCs proliferation in Qihe crucian carp.
statement: 在本研究中，我们观察到齐河鲫鱼的上皮脱落和氯化物细胞增殖。
text_zh: 在本研究中，我们观察到齐河鲫鱼的上皮脱落和氯化物细胞增殖。
text_en: In this study, we observed epithelial detachment and chloride cell proliferation in Qihe crucian carp.

quote: These structural modifications in tissue organization and cell population may enhance gas diffusion efficiency in Qihe crucian carp under carbonate alkalinity stress, thereby improving oxygen uptake to counteract the adverse effects of high carbonate alkalinity on it
statement: 这些组织结构及细胞群落的改变可能在碳酸盐碱度胁迫下提高齐河鲫鱼的气体扩散效率，从而改善氧气摄取以抵消高碳酸盐碱度的不利影响。
text_zh: 这些组织结构及细胞群落的改变可能在碳酸盐碱度胁迫下提高齐河鲫鱼的气体扩散效率，从而改善氧气摄取以抵消高碳酸盐碱度的不利影响。
text_en: These changes in tissue structure and cell communities may improve gas diffusion efficiency in Qihe crucian carp under carbonate alkalinity stress, thereby enhancing oxygen uptake to offset the adverse effects of high carbonate alkalinity.
intervention_record: 碱度胁迫下的结构修饰

quote: Previous studies have demonstrated that several economic aquatic animals, such as Nile tilapia and largemouth bass, can survive and grow normally in low-alkalinity waters (14 , 23 ].
statement: 先前的研究表明，尼罗罗非鱼和大口黑鲷等几种经济水生动物可以在低碱度水中正常存活和生长。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，尼罗罗非鱼和大口黑鲷等几种经济水生动物可以在低碱度水中正常存活和生长。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that several economically important aquatic animals, such as Nile tilapia and black sea bream, can survive and grow normally in low alkalinity water.

population.species: 尼罗罗非鱼; 大口黑鲷

quote: Research has shown that carbonate alkaline stress can significantly inhibit the growth of fish.
statement: 研究表明，碳酸盐碱性胁迫会显著抑制鱼类的生长。
text_zh: 研究表明，碳酸盐碱性胁迫会显著抑制鱼类的生长。
text_en: Studies show that carbonate alkalinity stress significantly inhibits the growth of fish.

quote: For example, the growth performance of Songpu mirror carp was significantly inhibited in an alkaline environment [ 5 , 37 ].
statement: 例如，松浦镜鲤在碱性环境中的生长性能受到显著抑制。
text_zh: 例如，松浦镜鲤在碱性环境中的生长性能受到显著抑制。
text_en: For example, the growth performance of Puntius gonionotus (Matsuo mirror carp) was significantly inhibited in an alkaline environment.

quote: Specifically, growth may be enhanced within an optimal range of low alkalinity but be inhibited once alkalinity exceeds a certain threshold [ 12 , 15 ].
statement: 具体而言，在低碱度的最佳范围内生长可能会增强，但一旦碱度超过某个阈值就会受到抑制。
text_zh: 具体而言，在低碱度的最佳范围内生长可能会增强，但一旦碱度超过某个阈值就会受到抑制。
text_en: Specifically, growth may be enhanced within the optimal range of low alkalinity, but it is inhibited once alkalinity exceeds a certain threshold.

quote: Our results demonstrated that increasing alkalinity significantly impaired the growth performance of Qihe crucian carp, as evidenced by reduced FBW, WGR, and SGR.
statement: 我们的结果表明，增加碱度显著损害了齐河鲫的生长性能，表现为终末体重、体重增长率和特定生长率降低。
text_zh: 我们的结果表明，增加碱度显著损害了齐河鲫的生长性能，表现为终末体重、体重增长率和特定生长率降低。
text_en: Our results showed that increasing alkalinity significantly impaired the growth performance of Qihe crucian carp, as indicated by reduced final body weight, weight gain rate, and specific growth rate.

quote: This pattern mirrors trends reported in grass carp and largemouth bass [ 12 , 23 ].
statement: 这种模式与草鱼和大口黑鲷中报道的趋势一致。
text_zh: 这种模式与草鱼和大口黑鲷中报道的趋势一致。
text_en: This pattern is consistent with the trends reported in grass carp and black sea bream.

quote: Additionally, the CA40 group exhibited poorer growth performance compared to the CA20 group, indicating the existence of the dose effect of alkalinity stress, as observed in largemouth bass [ 23 ].
statement: 此外，CA40组的生长性能比CA20组更差，表明存在碱度胁迫的剂量效应，这在大口黑鲷中也有观察到。
text_zh: 此外，CA40组的生长性能比CA20组更差，表明存在碱度胁迫的剂量效应，这在大口黑鲷中也有观察到。
text_en: In addition, the growth performance of the CA40 group was worse than that of the CA20 group, indicating a dose effect of alkalinity stress, which has also been observed in black sea bream.

quote: Molecular tools such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) and quantitative real-time PCR have been established for the detection and quantification of CyHV-2
statement: 已建立聚合酶链反应（PCR）和实时定量PCR等分子工具用于检测CyHV-2。
text_zh: 已建立聚合酶链反应（PCR）和实时定量PCR等分子工具用于检测CyHV-2。
text_en: Molecular tools such as polymerase chain reaction (PCR) and real-time quantitative PCR have been established for the detection of CyHV-2.

quote: Therefore, LAMP has been a useful tool for the diagnosis of aquatic animal diseases.
statement: 因此，LAMP已成为诊断水生动物疾病的有用工具。
text_zh: 因此，LAMP已成为诊断水生动物疾病的有用工具。
text_en: Therefore, LAMP has become a useful tool for diagnosing aquatic animal diseases.

quote: A rapid and sensitive loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) assay for Cyprinid herpesvirus 2 (CyHV-2) detection in gibel carp was developed.
statement: 开发了一种用于快速、灵敏检测鲫鲤疱疹病毒2型（CyHV-2）的环介导等温扩增（LAMP）方法。
text_zh: 开发了一种用于快速、灵敏检测鲫鲤疱疹病毒2型（CyHV-2）的环介导等温扩增（LAMP）方法。
text_en: A loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) method was developed for the rapid and sensitive detection of Cyprinid herpesvirus 2 (CyHV-2).

quote: A comparative evaluation of 10 fish samples using LAMP and nested PCR assays showed an overall correlation in positive and negative results for CyHV-2.
statement: 对10个鱼类样本使用LAMP和巢式PCR进行的比较评估显示，两者在CyHV-2阳性和阴性结果上总体一致。
text_zh: 对10个鱼类样本使用LAMP和巢式PCR进行的比较评估显示，两者在CyHV-2阳性和阴性结果上总体一致。
text_en: A comparative evaluation using LAMP and nested PCR on 10 fish samples showed overall agreement between the two methods for CyHV-2 positive and negative results.

quote: The LAMP assay result showed that a typical ladder-like pattern was observed only when the CyHV-2 DNA was present.
statement: LAMP检测结果仅在有CyHV-2 DNA存在时显示出典型的梯状条带模式。
text_zh: LAMP检测结果仅在有CyHV-2 DNA存在时显示出典型的梯状条带模式。
text_en: LAMP test results showed a typical ladder-like band pattern only when CyHV-2 DNA was present.

quote: It has an established role as a fish pathogen and has been associated with motile Aeromonas septicaemia and ulcer syndrome in cultured fresh water food fish [7] , [8] and tropical ornamental fish [9] , [10] , leading to severe economic losses.
statement: A. veronii is an established fish pathogen associated with motile Aeromonas septicaemia and ulcer syndrome in cultured freshwater food fish and tropical ornamental fish, causing severe economic losses.
text_en: A. veronii is an established fish pathogen associated with motile Aeromonas septicaemia and ulcer syndrome in cultured freshwater food fish and tropical ornamental fish, causing severe economic losses.

population.species: cultured fresh water food fish; tropical ornamental fish

quote: This clinical isolate showed resistance to multiple antimicrobials; amoxicillin, neomycin, trimethoprim-sulphonamide, chloramphenicol, tetracycline, enrofloxacin, erythromycin and nitrofurantoin.
statement: 该临床分离株对多种抗菌药物表现出耐药性，包括阿莫西林、新霉素、甲氧苄啶-磺胺甲噁唑、氯霉素、四环素、恩诺沙星、红霉素和呋喃妥因。
text_zh: 该临床分离株对多种抗菌药物表现出耐药性，包括阿莫西林、新霉素、甲氧苄啶-磺胺甲噁唑、氯霉素、四环素、恩诺沙星、红霉素和呋喃妥因。
text_en: This clinical isolate exhibited resistance to multiple antimicrobial agents, including amoxicillin, neomycin, trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole, chloramphenicol, tetracycline, enrofloxacin, erythromycin, and nitrofurantoin.

quote: When fish samples were tested, the LAMP assay results correlated strongly with nested PCR results for CyHV-2 detection (data not shown).
statement: 在鱼类样本测试中，LAMP检测结果与用于鲤疱疹病毒2型（CyHV-2）检测的巢式PCR结果高度相关。
text_zh: 在鱼类样本测试中，LAMP检测结果与用于鲤疱疹病毒2型（CyHV-2）检测的巢式PCR结果高度相关。
text_en: In fish sample tests, LAMP detection results were highly correlated with nested PCR results used for the detection of Cyprinid herpesvirus 2 (CyHV-2).

quote: The positive samples tested by nested PCR also gave positive reactions with LAMP, and no sample that was negative by nested PCR tested positive with the LAMP assay, which proved the applicability of the assay in CyHV-2 disease diagnosis.
statement: 巢式PCR阳性样本在LAMP中也为阳性，且无假阳性出现，证明了该检测方法在CyHV-2疾病诊断中的适用性。
text_zh: 巢式PCR阳性样本在LAMP中也为阳性，且无假阳性出现，证明了该检测方法在CyHV-2疾病诊断中的适用性。
text_en: Nested PCR-positive samples were also positive in LAMP, and no false positives occurred, demonstrating the applicability of this detection method for CyHV-2 disease diagnosis.

quote: It is reported that the CyHV-2 is very difficult to be cultured in cells [ 1 – 4 , 31 ], so the PCR and real-time PCR assays are mainly used for detection and quantification of CyHV-2 [ 1 – 7 ].
statement: 据报道CyHV-2很难在细胞中培养，因此PCR和实时荧光定量PCR主要用于其检测和定量。
text_zh: 据报道CyHV-2很难在细胞中培养，因此PCR和实时荧光定量PCR主要用于其检测和定量。
text_en: It is reported that CyHV-2 is difficult to culture in cells, therefore PCR and real-time fluorescent quantitative PCR are mainly used for its detection and quantification.

quote: Our final goal is to exploit a simple and rapid diagnostic kit for diagnosis and monitoring of CyHV-2 in fish farms, as it does not require special equipment.
statement: 最终目标是开发一种简单快速的诊断试剂盒，用于渔场中CyHV-2的诊断和监测，因为它不需要特殊设备。
text_zh: 最终目标是开发一种简单快速的诊断试剂盒，用于渔场中CyHV-2的诊断和监测，因为它不需要特殊设备。
text_en: The ultimate goal is to develop a simple and rapid diagnostic kit for the diagnosis and monitoring of CyHV-2 in fish farms, as it does not require special equipment.

quote: In conclusion, a simple, rapid, and sensitive LAMP assay to detect CyHV-2 in fish was developed and validated.
statement: 总之，开发并验证了一种简单、快速且灵敏的LAMP检测方法，用于检测鱼体内的CyHV-2。
text_zh: 总之，开发并验证了一种简单、快速且灵敏的LAMP检测方法，用于检测鱼体内的CyHV-2。
text_en: In summary, a simple, rapid and sensitive LAMP detection method was developed and validated for detecting CyHV-2 in fish.

quote: Fish were left unfed for 48 h before the injection.
statement: 实验前鱼被禁食48小时。
text_zh: 实验前鱼被禁食48小时。
text_en: Fish were fasted for 48 hours before the experiment.

quote: Fish were lightly anaesthetised with MS-222 (60 mg/l, Sigma) and weighed, after which they were administered an intraperitoneal injection of rt-hLEP (1·5 μg/g body weight, Pepro Tech Inc.) or 5 μl of PBS alone per g fish body weight (control), then distributed into triplicate tanks per treatment.
statement: 鱼经MS-222轻度麻醉称重后，接受腹腔注射rt-hLEP或PBS对照，并分入重复水箱。
text_zh: 鱼经MS-222轻度麻醉称重后，接受腹腔注射rt-hLEP或PBS对照，并分入重复水箱。
text_en: Fish were lightly anesthetized with MS-222 and weighed, then received intraperitoneal injection of rt-hLEP or PBS control, and were assigned to replicate tanks.

quote: Six fish per treatment (from three tanks) were anaesthetised and sampled at 6, 12, 24 and 48 h after injection.
statement: 每个处理组从三个水箱中选取六条鱼，在注射后6、12、24和48小时进行麻醉采样。
text_zh: 每个处理组从三个水箱中选取六条鱼，在注射后6、12、24和48小时进行麻醉采样。
text_en: Six fish were selected from three tanks in each treatment group and anesthetized for sampling at 6, 12, 24, and 48 hours after injection.

quote: After blood was removed, the fish were killed, and the entire liver and dorsal muscle were analysed, quickly frozen in liquid N2, and stored at –80°C until use.
statement: 采血后处死鱼，分析肝脏和背肌，组织迅速液氮冷冻并在-80°C保存。
text_zh: 采血后处死鱼，分析肝脏和背肌，组织迅速液氮冷冻并在-80°C保存。
text_en: Fish were euthanized after blood sampling, and liver and dorsal muscle were analyzed; tissues were rapidly frozen in liquid nitrogen and stored at -80°C.

quote: In this study, the LAMP assay for CyHV-2 detection was developed successfully.
statement: 本研究成功开发了用于检测CyHV-2的LAMP检测方法。
text_zh: 本研究成功开发了用于检测CyHV-2的LAMP检测方法。
text_en: This study successfully developed a LAMP detection method for detecting CyHV-2.

quote:
Ninety-six fish (DT strain body weight 9·43 (SE 0·17) g;
A strain body weight 8·20 (SE 0·13) g) were raised in sixteen
fibreglass tanks (water volume 300 l) maintained a constant water
temperature of 17°C.
statement: 96尾鱼被饲养在16个玻璃钢水箱中，水温恒定维持在17°C。
text_zh: 96尾鱼被饲养在16个玻璃钢水箱中，水温恒定维持在17°C。
text_en: 96 fish were reared in 16 fiberglass-reinforced plastic tanks, with the water temperature maintained at a constant 17°C.

population.system: 室内循环水/静水养殖系统

quote:
Fish were hand-fed (feed 30 % carbohydrate
and 8 % lipid) to apparent satiation twice per day (09.00 and 15.00
hours).
statement: 鱼每天两次（09:00和15:00）人工投喂含30%碳水化合物和8%脂质的饲料至表观饱食。
text_zh: 鱼每天两次（09:00和15:00）人工投喂含30%碳水化合物和8%脂质的饲料至表观饱食。
text_en: Fish were manually fed a diet containing 30% carbohydrates and 8% lipids to apparent satiation twice daily (at 09:00 and 15:00).

quote:
Water quality was monitored twice a week, with ammonia
nitrogen concentration <0·1 mg/l and pH of about 6·5.
statement: 每周监测两次水质，氨氮浓度低于0.1 mg/l，pH值约为6.5。
text_zh: 每周监测两次水质，氨氮浓度低于0.1 mg/l，pH值约为6.5。
text_en: Water quality is monitored twice a week, with ammonia nitrogen concentration below 0.1 mg/l and pH value about 6.5.

quote: Higher glucose lev-els were found in the A strain compared with the DT strain at the 24-h time point.
statement: The A strain exhibited higher glucose levels than the DT strain at the 24-hour time point.
text_en: The A strain exhibited higher glucose levels than the DT strain at the 24-hour time point.

quote: The moribund gibel carps displayed typical external symptoms within 24 h after infection by YC-01, including hyperemia at the base of the fins, abdomen hemorrhage, anus hyperemia, sunken eyes, and severe gill hemorrhage
statement: 感染YC-01毒株后，濒死的鲫鱼在24小时内表现出鳍基充血、腹部出血、肛门充血、眼球凹陷和严重的鳃出血等典型外部症状。
text_zh: 感染YC-01毒株后，濒死的鲫鱼在24小时内表现出鳍基充血、腹部出血、肛门充血、眼球凹陷和严重的鳃出血等典型外部症状。
text_en: After infection with the YC-01 strain, moribund crucian carp exhibited typical external symptoms within 24 hours, including fin base congestion, abdominal hemorrhage, anal congestion, sunken eyes, and severe gill hemorrhage.

quote: CyHV-2 appears to be widespread in goldfish throughout the world, causing high mortality among juvenile goldfish in water at 15–25 °C [ 11 , 12 ].
statement: CyHV-2似乎在全球范围内广泛存在于金鱼中，导致在15–25°C水温下的幼年金鱼高死亡率。
text_zh: CyHV-2似乎在全球范围内广泛存在于金鱼中，导致在15–25°C水温下的幼年金鱼高死亡率。
text_en: CyHV-2 appears to be widely present in goldfish globally, causing high mortality in juvenile goldfish at water temperatures of 15–25°C.

quote: Notably, the symptoms of CyHV-2 infection in crucian carp are significantly more severe than those in goldfish, including pale gills and swollen spleens and kidneys
statement: 值得注意的是，鲫鱼感染CyHV-2的症状比金鱼严重得多，包括鳃苍白和脾脏及肾脏肿胀。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，鲫鱼感染CyHV-2的症状比金鱼严重得多，包括鳃苍白和脾脏及肾脏肿胀。
text_en: It is worth noting that the symptoms of CyHV-2 infection in crucian carp are much more severe than those in goldfish, including pale gills and swollen spleen and kidneys.

quote: Research in the past decade has mainly focused on identification of CyHV-2 through detection and genome sequencing, including the development of vaccines and drugs targeting CyHV-2
statement: 过去十年的研究主要集中在通过检测和基因组测序鉴定CyHV-2，包括开发针对CyHV-2的疫苗和药物。
text_zh: 过去十年的研究主要集中在通过检测和基因组测序鉴定CyHV-2，包括开发针对CyHV-2的疫苗和药物。
text_en: Research over the past decade has mainly focused on identifying CyHV-2 through detection and genomic sequencing, including the development of vaccines and drugs targeting CyHV-2.

quote: CyHV-2 infections have resulting in severe economic losses in all farmed fishes of Carassius species including gibel carp suffered from the HVHN with different levels of susceptibility and mortality in China
statement: CyHV-2感染导致中国养殖的鲤鲫属鱼类（包括银鲫）遭受严重的经济损失，并表现出不同程度的易感性和死亡率。
text_zh: CyHV-2感染导致中国养殖的鲤鲫属鱼类（包括银鲫）遭受严重的经济损失，并表现出不同程度的易感性和死亡率。
text_en: CyHV-2 infection causes severe economic losses in farmed Cyprinus and Carassius fish species in China (including silver crucian carp) and exhibits varying degrees of susceptibility and mortality.

quote: After blood and the fin tissue were gathered, all samples were kept alive.
statement: 在采集血液和鳍组织后，所有样本均被保持存活。
text_zh: 在采集血液和鳍组织后，所有样本均被保持存活。
text_en: After collecting blood and fin tissue, all samples were kept alive.
intervention: Live sampling of blood and fin

quote: Diseases cause serious economic losses to the gibel carp farming industry.
statement: 疾病给鲫鱼养殖行业造成了严重的经济损失。
text_zh: 疾病给鲫鱼养殖行业造成了严重的经济损失。
text_en: Disease has caused severe economic losses to the crucian carp farming industry.

quote: Cases of cyprinid herpesvirus 2 (CyHV-2) infection were reported in gibel carp farms in central China from 2011 to 2012 [ 2 ].
statement: 2011年至2012年间，中国中部的鲫鱼养殖场报告了鲤疱疹病毒2型（CyHV-2）感染病例。
text_zh: 2011年至2012年间，中国中部的鲫鱼养殖场报告了鲤疱疹病毒2型（CyHV-2）感染病例。
text_en: Between 2011 and 2012, carp herpesvirus type 2 (CyHV-2) infection cases were reported in crucian carp farms in central China.

quote: CyHV-2 infection was originally identified as herpesviral hematopoietic necrosis (HVHN) in goldfish, with high mortality, in Japan in 1995 [ 6 ].
statement: CyHV-2感染最初于1995年在日本的金鱼中被鉴定为疱疹病毒性造血坏死（HVHN），具有高死亡率。
text_zh: CyHV-2感染最初于1995年在日本的金鱼中被鉴定为疱疹病毒性造血坏死（HVHN），具有高死亡率。
text_en: CyHV-2 infection was first identified in goldfish in Japan in 1995 as herpesviral hematopoietic necrosis (HVHN), with high mortality.

quote: CyHV-2 infections in crucian carp [ 8 ], goldfish [ 9 ], gibel carp [ 3 ], and other inbred hybrids of Carassius [ 10 ] causing HVHN with different susceptibilities and mortalities, have been reported in China.
statement: 在中国，已报道Crucian carp、金鱼、鲫鱼及其他Carassius近交杂交种感染CyHV-2引起具有不同易感性和死亡率的HVHN。
text_zh: 在中国，已报道Crucian carp、金鱼、鲫鱼及其他Carassius近交杂交种感染CyHV-2引起具有不同易感性和死亡率的HVHN。
text_en: In China, HVHN caused by CyHV-2 infection has been reported in crucian carp, goldfish, Carassius auratus, and other Carassius inbred hybrid species, with varying susceptibility and mortality rates.

population.species: crucian carp, goldfish, gibel carp, inbred hybrids of Carassius

quote: Then they demonstrated the relevance of ORF150 as a virulence factor by targeted deletion and indicated that ORF150-deleted CyHV-3 can be used as an efﬁcacious and safe vaccine in carp production
statement: 通过靶向删除ORF150证明了其作为毒力因子的相关性，并表明缺失ORF150的CyHV-3可用作鲤鱼生产中有效且安全的疫苗。
text_zh: 通过靶向删除ORF150证明了其作为毒力因子的相关性，并表明缺失ORF150的CyHV-3可用作鲤鱼生产中有效且安全的疫苗。
text_en: The relevance of ORF150 as a virulence factor was demonstrated by targeted deletion, and it was shown that CyHV-3 lacking ORF150 can be used as an effective and safe vaccine in carp production.

quote: There is some evidence suggesting that the three viruses can remain latent in clinically healthy fish, and that the infection can be reactivated by some stress
statement: 有证据表明这三种病毒可以在临床健康的鱼体内保持潜伏状态，且感染可被某些应激因素重新激活。
text_zh: 有证据表明这三种病毒可以在临床健康的鱼体内保持潜伏状态，且感染可被某些应激因素重新激活。
text_en: There is evidence that these three viruses can remain latent in clinically healthy fish, and infection can be reactivated by certain stress factors.

quote: lesions caused by CyHV-1 usually develop when water temperature is lower than 15 °C; disease outbreaks induced by CyHV-2 mainly occur between 15 and 25 °C; outbreaks infected by CyHV-3 appear when the water temperature is 18–28 °C
statement: CyHV-1引起的病变通常在水温低于15°C时发展；CyHV-2诱导的疾病爆发主要发生在15至25°C之间；CyHV-3感染的爆发出现在水温为18–28°C时。
text_zh: CyHV-1引起的病变通常在水温低于15°C时发展；CyHV-2诱导的疾病爆发主要发生在15至25°C之间；CyHV-3感染的爆发出现在水温为18–28°C时。
text_en: Lesions caused by CyHV-1 typically develop at water temperatures below 15°C; disease outbreaks induced by CyHV-2 occur mainly between 15 and 25°C; outbreaks of CyHV-3 infection appear at water temperatures of 18–28°C.

quote: based on whole-genome sequencing, many nucleic acid and immunological assays have been developed to specifically detect these viruses
statement: 基于全基因组测序，已开发出许多核酸和免疫学检测方法以特异性检测这些病毒。
text_zh: 基于全基因组测序，已开发出许多核酸和免疫学检测方法以特异性检测这些病毒。
text_en: Based on whole genome sequencing, many nucleic acid and immunological detection methods have been developed to specifically detect these viruses.

quote: Previous evidence indicated that B. cereus G19 could affect microbial interactions and increase the number of generalists to improve the intestinal microbiota homeostasis (21).
statement: 先前的证据表明，蜡样芽孢杆菌G19可以影响微生物相互作用并增加泛化种的数量，从而改善肠道微生物群稳态。
text_zh: 先前的证据表明，蜡样芽孢杆菌G19可以影响微生物相互作用并增加泛化种的数量，从而改善肠道微生物群稳态。
text_en: Previous evidence indicates that Bacillus cereus G19 can influence microbial interactions and increase the number of generalist species, thereby improving gut microbiota homeostasis.

quote: Previous studies of crucian carp confirmed that high plant protein diets were damaged to the intestinal health (29 , 30), while probiotics Bacillus could recover the negative effects and improve growth, antioxidant capability and filet quality (31 – 34).
statement: 先前的鲫鱼研究证实，高植物蛋白日粮会损害肠道健康，而芽孢杆菌属益生菌可以恢复负面影响并改善生长、抗氧化能力和鱼肉品质。
text_zh: 先前的鲫鱼研究证实，高植物蛋白日粮会损害肠道健康，而芽孢杆菌属益生菌可以恢复负面影响并改善生长、抗氧化能力和鱼肉品质。
text_en: Previous crucian carp studies confirmed that high plant protein diets impair gut health, while Bacillus probiotics can reverse the negative effects and improve growth, antioxidant capacity, and fish meat quality.

population.species: Pengze crucian carp (Carassius auratus var. Pengze)

outcome: 肠道健康、生长性能、抗氧化能力、肉质
counterevidence: 高植物蛋白日粮损害肠道健康

quote: Compared to the Control group, dietary supplementation of B. cereus increased the number of observed OTUs, Chao1, ACE, Shannon, and Simpson in bacterial community of Pengze crucian carp, whilst a significant difference was recorded in Shannon and Simpson (P Table 1).
statement: 与对照组相比，饲料中添加蜡样芽孢杆菌增加了彭泽鲫细菌群落中观察到的OTU数量、Chao1、ACE、Shannon和Simpson指数，其中Shannon和Simpson指数记录了显著差异。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，饲料中添加蜡样芽孢杆菌增加了彭泽鲫细菌群落中观察到的OTU数量、Chao1、ACE、Shannon和Simpson指数，其中Shannon和Simpson指数记录了显著差异。
text_en: Compared with the control group, Bacillus cereus supplementation in feed increased the number of observed OTUs, Chao1, ACE, Shannon and Simpson indices in the bacterial community of Pengze crucian carp, with significant differences recorded for the Shannon and Simpson indices.

quote: However, no notable difference in α-diversity index mentioned above was observed between BS and Control groups.
statement: 然而，在BS组和对照组之间未观察到上述α多样性指数的显著差异。
text_zh: 然而，在BS组和对照组之间未观察到上述α多样性指数的显著差异。
text_en: However, no significant difference was observed in the above alpha diversity indices between the BS group and the control group.
counterevidence: 前文提到B. cereus组有显著差异，此处指出BS组无显著差异，暗示不同处理或比较对象导致结果不一致。

quote: And then, abundant fresh cells of the Bacillus cereus (CD group) and B. subtilis (BS group) obtained through spreading cultivation, and mixed thoroughly with the basal diets at the dose of 1 × 10 9 CFU/kg by spraying.
statement: Fresh cells of Bacillus cereus and B. subtilis were mixed with basal diets at a dose of 1 × 10^9 CFU/kg by spraying.
text_en: Fresh cells of Bacillus cereus and B. subtilis were mixed with basal diets at a dose of 1 × 10^9 CFU/kg by spraying.

quote: Fish were fed to apparent satiation three times a day (8: 00, 13: 00, and 16: 00) for 70 days.
statement: Fish were fed to apparent satiation three times daily for 70 days.
text_en: Fish were fed to apparent satiation three times daily for 70 days.

quote: During the experimental period, water quality conditions were stable (water temperature, 25.5 ± 3.2°C; dissolved oxygen > 6.0 mg L −1 ; NH4 + -N −1 ; NO 2 - -N −1 , respectively).
statement: Water quality conditions remained stable during the experiment, with specific values recorded for temperature, dissolved oxygen, ammonia nitrogen, and nitrite nitrogen.
